title: fix: clarify community monitor stream errors
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Reports usage_missing as missing or invalid token usage instead of a missing choices array.
- Identifies other error events without exposing private provider messages.
- Extracts the existing parser for regression tests and includes it in monitor installation.
- Leaves billing, stream acceptance, cadence, and hiding rules unchanged.

Tests: 3 parser tests pass; Biome, Node syntax checks, and updater shell syntax check pass.

gist.headline: The monitor reads the room
gist.blurb: The community monitor now tells a missing token-usage report from a missing choices array. Private provider chatter remains politely behind the curtain.
gist.summary: Extracted the community monitor chat-stream parser into chat-stream.mjs with regression tests, so usage_missing events report missing or invalid token usage and other stream errors are identified without exposing provider messages.
gist.impact: Monitor operators get clearer, safer stream diagnostics while billing, stream acceptance, polling cadence, and existing hiding rules continue unchanged.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy community monitoring station: Polli watches a CRT terminal sort stream-event cards into clearly labeled trays for token usage and safe generic errors, while private notes remain tucked inside a locked little drawer. Small code-plants and flowers show that the monitor is being maintained rather than redesigned.
